limits.sensitivity: Sensitivity-direction benchmark (pre-registered, Track A): model 2/8 on the original 8 modellable items, always-increase 4/8, blind no-tool baseline 6/8; held-out j1-j3 (n = 3, one paper) model 0/3 (docs/track_a_results.md).
limits.shape: Shape-class benchmark: accuracy 0.50, equal to the always-triangle baseline (n = 14, 8 in scope; docs/track_a_results.md). Shape class is a hypothesis.

tiers.cvd_tube: Tier 1. MoO3 vapour pressure from Smolik et al. 2000 (solid branch only; no sourced liquid-MoO3 branch above the 1068 K melting point, so the model cannot respond to a hotter boat). Shape map: hypothesis. Edge rates are synthetic; DFT Mo-edge S binding (Rosen et al. 2018) is an option and the map is still not predictive (shape accuracy 0.50 = always-triangle baseline, n = 14, 8 in scope). Sensitivity direction (pre-registered, Track A): original 8 items model 2/8 vs blind no-tool baseline 6/8 vs always-increase 4/8; held-out j1-j3 (one paper) 0/3, no claim; handles added for MoO3/S inventory and source-substrate gap. Tier 0 regime call re-derived with a wall-uptake driving-force term; agrees with the CFD convention on 37/40 sweep cases (was 26/40); the CFD label is an agent-chosen convention (63 % uptake), not measured. Mesh: tube GCI 0.8-13 %, mostly oscillatory (target 2 % missed). Surrogate: multi-fidelity correction does not reach 5 % (LOO median error 24-36 %); tube outputs span 3.5-6.6 decades of CFD/Tier 1 and are not learnable from 40 cases.
tiers.ampoule: Tier 1. Thermochemistry sourced for WO2 + HgX2 presets, but the model over-predicts published transport rates by about 1x to 38x (not tuned). Convection enhancement is CFD-calibrated (laminar, square duct for tilts) and flagged outside the scanned range. 60-case CFD sweep: Tier 0 agreement 81.7 % (threshold 1.1) / 75 % (1.2) with the CFD f>1.1 / f>1.2 convention; the stratification fix adds nothing over no stratification term when scored held-out (tier2/verification/b3_results.json). Finest mesh done: GCI 0.0-2.1 % on 3 steady cases, 13 % (unsteady, not meaningful) on the strong-convection case. Surrogate: correction does not reach 5 % (LOO median error 27-31 %), and adds essentially nothing over Tier 1. A possible sign error in Tier 1's composition-buoyancy term is unchecked. OpenFOAM matches Tier 1 within 2 % for diffusion-limited cases.
